headline: 🐧 Auto-Color Linux backdoor rootkit analysis, 🇨🇳 PackClient RAT tax phishing campaign, 🇩🇪 Berlin ransom demand widens, 🏥 PEAR leaks 1.4TB from Texas health org, 🏛️ US officials walk back China hack claims, 💊 McKesson 284M records claim
summary: A deep-dive analysis of the Auto-Color Linux backdoor reveals LD_PRELOAD rootkit tradecraft targeting universities and government offices. Chinese threat actor TA4922 deploys PackClient RAT via tax-themed phishing in China and India. Berlin refuses to disclose scope of administrative network breach as hackers demand 30 bitcoin. PEAR ransomware leaks data from South Plains Rural Health Services. US officials revise claims about Chinese government agency intrusions. ShinyHunters claims 284M patient records from McKesson.
